Fixed. The root cause: every `render()` call created a fresh `IdMask` (id counter) on the new root vnode in src/render.js:34, resetting the counter to 0 while already-mounted components kept their old ids from hook state — producing duplicates like `P0-0` twice.

The fix (src/render.js:34-38) reuses the previous root's mask (`oldVNode._mask`) when diffing into the same container, so the counter continues across invocations of `render`/`hydrate` on the same DOM node. Fresh mounts (and each `renderToString` call) still start at 0.
